punchline: If you lose 50 percent, you need to gain 100 percent just to get back to even.
thirty_sec: In Money: Master the Game, Tony Robbins found that top investors obsess over avoiding big losses. Buffett's rule one is never lose money. A 50 percent loss needs a 100 percent gain to recover. Paul Tudor Jones seeks asymmetric bets where reward is at least five times risk, so he can be wrong often and still win. Ray Dalio's All Weather portfolio aims to survive every economic season.
